sentences.en: The safeguard of the state shall be the supreme law.
sentences.zh: 国家保护条款应成为最高的法律。

sentences.en: Mrs. Barrett will become the fifth female Supreme Court justice.
sentences.zh: 巴雷特女士将成为第五位女性最高法院大法官。

sentences.en: The Supreme Court is located near the Imperial Palace.
sentences.zh: 最高法院位于皇宫附近。

senses.zh: 最高的；至高的；最重要的
